description: xHE-AAC (USAC) files by other encoders than the fixtures' exhale, which show how each lays out its UsacConfig: the ISO/IEC 23003-3 conformance streams in FFmpeg's FATE suite, Fraunhofer's demonstration files, and one exhale file from the FATE suite. They are downloaded and checked against their SHA-256 rather than committed. Per file: who wrote it, the elements of its UsacDecoderConfig (EXT with its extension element type: 0 fill, 3 audio pre-roll; CPE+MPS212 for a channel pair element with MPEG Surround 2-1-2 stereo), the types of its configuration extensions (2 loudness info, 7 stream ID), the encoder and confidence the analyzer must report, and its warnings and errors ("findings").
